title: Signing in
intro: Depot opens in your web browser. You sign in once and it remembers you on that computer.

sections.heading: Open the sign-in page
text: Your company gives you the Depot address. It works in any up-to-date browser, such as Edge, Chrome or Safari.
steps: Open your web browser and go to the Depot address.
Click **Sign in with Microsoft 365** if your company has turned on Microsoft 365 sign-in.
Otherwise click **Sign in with email & password** and enter the details your company gave you.
sections.tip: Add the Depot address to your browser's bookmarks. Then you can open it again with one click.

sections.heading: Choose how to sign in
text: The sign-in card shows the ways your company allows. You may see one button or two.
steps: Click **Sign in with Microsoft 365** to use your work account.
Click **Sign in with email & password** to use a Depot password.
bullets: After you sign in, Depot opens on **Home**.
If you opened a link from a share email, Depot takes you straight to that file.
sections.note: Depot has no **Forgot password** button. If you cannot sign in, ask the person who looks after Depot at your company.
